comment: Named empty host functions and inert hook lambdas. This count may only fall. It was re-established when the empty-lambda-arg pattern was added: that pattern exposed 19 do-nothing hook edges the assigned-lambda pattern had never seen. Thirteen of those were fixed on the spot; the rest are edges whose subsystem the host does not build. see tools/runtime_placeholder_audit.py.

exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tstatic_cast<sh: Retail 0x0042F540's change callback refreshes the menu display copy; the host reads the live DAT_00474E88 table directly each frame (no display copy), and the keyconfig exit branch republishes the table into the config record, so the notification edge has no host-side work.
exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tvoid HostMaybe: Compile-time stub: the non-_WIN32/capture-less build has no D3D back buffer to read; the _WIN32 definition above implements the capture.
exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tvoid HostNop(v: Generic inert edge for retail sequence callbacks with no host-side counterpart: select_primary_camera (single-camera immediate-mode host), stop_game_thread (host runs the frame on the calling thread and starts no worker; documented at the binding), and the MainTasks_Shutdown edges (the host performs its own teardown in later WinMain-order hooks).
exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tvoid HostRelea: WinMain-order hook; the host's resources are owned and released by the dedicated later hooks (HostReleaseDeviceChain, HostDestroySound, HostDestroyGameState) rather than a separate resource set.
exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tvoid HostDestr: The host's scheduler is static host state with no per-instance ownership to release; process teardown owns it.
exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tvoid HostSound: The host audio layer never allocates the retail track table (documented at the definition); the teardown-sequence edge has nothing to act on.
exempt.standalone/host_main.cpp\tvoid HostMidiN: The host has no MIDI player at all (documented at the definition); every retail MIDI teardown edge has nothing to act on.
exempt.standalone/host_stage.cpp\tvoid HostMode: Mode transitions run on the single main thread; the only worker thread (sound) never reads mode state, so the critical-section edge guards no concurrent access.
